summary: Loretta Mester, former President of the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, delivered this speech in May 2016 discussing inflation dynamics and the challenges of achieving the Fed's 2% PCE inflation target. The speech reviews low inflation conditions across the US, UK, and Euro area in 2015, citing weak global demand, energy/commodity price declines, and dollar strength as contributing factors. The speech is explicitly framed as her own views rather than official FOMC policy signals.
